note: Potomac-Garrett State Forest, dispersed campsites along Snaggy Mountain road between Cranesville road and Sanders lane.  Self-registration kiosk on Snaggy Mountain road near Cranesville road.  --AWH
summary: Confirmed on DNR's current Potomac-Garrett recreation page: 10 sites, first-come first-served, $10/night, 14-night maximum; added year-round season and vault toilets. Note: dropped the site count and price AWH's note repeats. Not stated: road condition, rig length, water.
flags: Website: https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/PotomacGarrett/Camping.aspx is dead (404, redirects to DNR's page-not-found); DNR's current camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/PotomacGarrett/recreation-trails.aspx (forest home page https://dnr.maryland.gov/forests/Pages/publiclands/western_potomacgarrettforest.aspx). The website field also lists https://freecampsites.net, an aggregator.

Rig fit not confirmed by DNR: the forest's pages describe primitive sites (picnic table, lantern post, fire ring) on forest roads but say nothing about road condition, four-wheel drive, or what length of unit the sites take; the area maps show the roads as 'Forest Access Road'.
